{"type":"thought","data":"The search results are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" very informative."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRealClearPolling shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 38.1% approval rating"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as of October 11. A"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2026-10-05 article "}
{"type":"thought","data":"reports 38.5% on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 5, but the sidebar "}
{"type":"thought","data":"may reflect a more recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" snapshot of 37.8%. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"These figures are close"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to the 37.6 threshold."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 38.1% figure is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" an average of 14 polls"}
{"type":"thought","data":" spanning September 21 to October 11. Individual"}
{"type":"thought","data":" polls range from 30%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 44%. The exact weighting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and date window used"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by RealClearPolling"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are being verified."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 38.1% average "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is confirmed by summing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the listed poll values and dividing by 14. The market closes on October 16 at 5 PM ET, so the final resolution"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will likely reflect"}
{"type":"thought","data":" polls through that "}
{"type":"thought","data":"date."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 38.1% average "}
{"type":"thought","data":"sits 0.5 points above"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 37.6 threshold,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so it must hold steady"}
{"type":"thought","data":" over the next three"}
{"type":"thought","data":" days. The October 5"}
{"type":"thought","data":" article's 38.5% figure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the sidebar's 37.8%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are inconsistent with the October 11 poll table, suggesting the sidebar reflects a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"more recent snapshot."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNate Silver's net "}
{"type":"thought","data":"approval is -21.9, hitting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" an all-time low of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"-23.5 over the weekend"}
{"type":"thought","data":" before bouncing. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" figure differs from RealClearPolling.\n\n"}
{"type":"thought","data":"fredcornell.com reports"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 35.0% approval on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 13, but that aggregator"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is not the resolution"}
{"type":"thought","data":" source.\n\nRasmussen "}
{"type":"thought","data":"shows 41% approval on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 13. Since Rasmussen"}
{"type":"thought","data":" was already in the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"RealClearPolling average at 41%, this poll likely does not shift the mean.\n\nMacromicro's favorability metric reads 38.6% on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 12, though it measures"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorability rather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than approval.\n\nThe sidebar's 37.8%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" figure may reflect "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the current live approval"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rating rather than a stale snapshot. If so, the market threshold"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sits only 0.2 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" below the current level,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" leaving almost no cushion"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for a decline over "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the next three days."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRealClearPolling averages"}
{"type":"thought","data":" change slowly because"}
{"type":"thought","data":" they span roughly three"}
{"type":"thought","data":" weeks. A 0.5-point "}
{"type":"thought","data":"cushion is not large"}
{"type":"thought","data":" enough to absorb a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"full-point swing over"}
{"type":"thought","data":" three days. Polls from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" September 21 through"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 27, such as Emerson"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Quinnipiac, may drop out of the window by October 16."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nIf older polls drop"}
{"type":"thought","data":" out of the window, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the average could rise."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Removing the low polls"}
{"type":"thought","data":" AP/NORC and Quinnipiac"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would push the mean"}
{"type":"thought","data":" upward to roughly 39%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Recent polls include Morning Consult at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"42%, Rasmussen at 41%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and several others "}
{"type":"thought","data":"in the 30% to 42% range."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNate Silver's net "}
{"type":"thought","data":"approval bounced to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"-21.9 on October 11 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"after hitting an all-time"}
{"type":"thought","data":" low of -23.5 over the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" weekend, driven by "}
{"type":"thought","data":"TIPP. fredcornell shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 35.0% average with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 95% confidence interval"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 32.8 to 37.2, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this uses a different"}
{"type":"thought","data":" methodology and is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"not the resolution source."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price sits"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.615, though the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" best bid is 0.54 and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the best ask is 0.69,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" creating a wide spread.\n\nThe `bench bet` command"}
{"type":"thought","data":" takes an outcome label,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a confidence score "}
{"type":"thought","data":"between 0 and 1, and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a rationale string. The confidence value is independent of the market price. Historical"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts show that winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pays roughly 20 to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"90 tokens depending "}
{"type":"thought","data":"on the price, while "}
{"type":"thought","data":"losing costs about 100"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe exact profit on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a winning bet depends"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on the fill price. Buying Yes at 0.615 yields roughly 62.6 tokens profit, but the best ask is 0.69, which would yield only about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 44.9. Buying No at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.385 yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 159.7 tokens profit,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while the best ask "}
{"type":"thought","data":"of 0.46 would yield "}
{"type":"thought","data":"about 117.4. The next step is to verify the exact bet mechanics with `bench bet --help`"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and to find a more "}
{"type":"thought","data":"current RealClearPolling"}
{"type":"thought","data":" average."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 37.6 threshold"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is deliberately set"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near the current 38.1"}
{"type":"thought","data":" reading, so the 61.5%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price reflects a market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expectation that the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" average will remain"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above the line. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" RCP average is sticky"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and slow-moving, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" supports the Yes side."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The key question is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" whether this cushion holds over the next three days."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe oldest polls that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may drop out are very"}
{"type":"thought","data":" low, so their removal"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would lift the average."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Morning Consult and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Rasmussen remain near 41–42%. One aggregator showed a slight upward bump of +0.2 points in the past week.\n\nThe downside scenario is plausible. The approval rating fell from 38.5 on October 5 to roughly 37.8 now, about a 0.7-point decline over eight days. A further 0.2-point drop over the next three days fits that downward trend."}

{"type":"tool_call","toolCallId":"call-02c0ed31-e79b-4a29-addb-a7a1a8b3fcbb-13","title":"run_terminal_command","kind":"execute","status":"pending","toolName":"run_terminal_command","rawInput":{"command":"python3 << 'PY'\nimport json, urllib.request\n\ndef get(url):\n    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=25) as r:\n        return json.load(r)\n\ndef show_markets(label, url):\n    print(\"====\", label, \"====\")\n    d = get(url)\n    mk = d.get(\"markets\", [])\n    print(\"count\", len(mk))\n    rows = []\n    for m in mk:\n        sub = m.get(\"yes_sub_title\") or m.get(\"subtitle\") or m.get(\"title\")\n        rows.append((\n            m.get(\"ticker\"),\n            sub,\n            m.get(\"yes_bid\"),\n            m.get(\"yes_ask\"),\n            m.get(\"last_price\"),\n            m.get(\"volume\"),\n            m.get(\"status\"),\n            m.get(\"result\"),\n        ))\n    # sort by ticker\n    for t, sub, bid, ask, last, vol, status, result in rows:\n        print(f\"{t} | {sub} | bid={bid} ask={ask} last={last} vol={vol} status={status} result={result}\")\n\nshow_markets(\"OCT13\", \"https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2/markets?event_ticker=KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26OCT13&limit=50\")\nshow_markets(\"OCT14\", \"https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2/markets?event_ticker=KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26OCT14&limit=50\")\nshow_markets(\"OCT16\", \"https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2/markets?event_ticker=KXAPRPOTUS-26OCT16&limit=50\")\n\nfor day in [\"26OCT12\",\"26OCT11\",\"26OCT10\",\"26OCT09\",\"26OCT08\",\"26OCT07\",\"26OCT06\",\"26OCT05\"]:\n    url = f\"https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2/markets?event_ticker=KXTRUMPAPPROVE-{day}&limit=50\"\n    d = get(url)\n    winners = []\n    for m in d.get(\"markets\", []):\n        if m.get(\"result\") == \"yes\":\n            winners.append(m.get(\"yes_sub_title\") or m.get(\"ticker\"))\n    print(day, \"WINNERS:\", winners)\nPY","description":"Parse Kalshi approval brackets and recent settlements"},"content":[],"locations":[]}

{"type":"tool_call","toolCallId":"call-91ca983f-dfbe-409e-96ef-2ee72edad455-15","title":"run_terminal_command","kind":"execute","status":"pending","toolName":"run_terminal_command","rawInput":{"command":"python3 << 'PY'\nimport json, urllib.request\n\ndef get(url):\n    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=25) as r:\n        return json.load(r)\n\ndef show(label, url):\n    print(\"====\", label)\n    d = get(url)\n    rows = []\n    for m in d[\"markets\"]:\n        yb = float(m[\"yes_bid_dollars\"] or 0)\n        ya = float(m[\"yes_ask_dollars\"] or 0)\n        last = float(m[\"last_price_dollars\"] or 0)\n        mid = (yb+ya)/2 if ya else last\n        rows.append((m[\"yes_sub_title\"], yb, ya, last, mid, m[\"volume_fp\"]))\n    # sort by subtitle roughly\n    rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])\n    s = 0\n    for sub, yb, ya, last, mid, vol in rows:\n        print(f\"  {sub:16} bid={yb:.2f} ask={ya:.2f} last={last:.2f} mid={mid:.3f} vol={vol}\")\n        s += mid\n    print(f\"  mid sum={s:.3f}\")\n\nshow(\"OCT13\", \"https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2/markets?event_ticker=KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26OCT13&limit=50\")\nshow(\"OCT14\", \"https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2/markets?event_ticker=KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26OCT14&limit=50\")\nshow(\"OCT16\", \"https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2/markets?event_ticker=KXAPRPOTUS-26OCT16&limit=50\")\n\n# polymarket search\nimport urllib.parse\nq = urllib.parse.quote(\"Trump approval rating 37.6 October 16\")\ntry:\n    d = get(f\"https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/public-search?q={q}\")\n    print(\"POLY keys\", d.keys() if isinstance(d, dict) else type(d))\n    print(json.dumps(d)[:2500])\nexcept Exception as e:\n    print(\"poly err\", e)\nPY","description":"Get live Kalshi mids and Polymarket search"},"content":[],"locations":[]}

{"type":"thought","data":"A major update concerns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the October 13 Kalshi"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market, which settles"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 1 PM ET today."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe October 13 Kalshi"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market is effectively"}
{"type":"thought","data":" locked at 38.4% with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near certainty. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.96 bid and 52,000"}
{"type":"thought","data":" volume indicate the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" RCP print is already"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fixed."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe October 14 market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows the probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of at least 37.6% is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" nearly 99%. The distribution"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is heavily weighted"}
{"type":"thought","data":" toward 38.3%, 38.4%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and above. The expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value for that date"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is being calculated."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for the October 14 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market is roughly 35.6."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The \"Above 38.4\" bucket"}
{"type":"thought","data":" dominates at about "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.475, followed by 38.4%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.235 and 38.3% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at 0.145."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for October 14 is refined"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to roughly 38.4, unchanged"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from today.\n\nFor the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 16 resolution"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market, the probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of the approval rating"}
{"type":"thought","data":" falling below 37.6%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is about 15.7%. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability of at least"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 37.6% is approximately"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 84.3%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe October 16 market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" was created on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 10, so its prices may"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be stale relative to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" today's jump to 38.4%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Recent trading activity"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows the below-37.6"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability has been"}
{"type":"thought","data":" falling as the rating"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rose. The market is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" live and updating."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA drop to below 37.6%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by October 16 would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" require roughly 0.8"}
{"type":"thought","data":" points in three days."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The largest recent "}
{"type":"thought","data":"single-day drop was "}
{"type":"thought","data":"only 0.5 points, so "}
{"type":"thought","data":"this is uncommon but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" possible.\n\nKalshi's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 16% probability for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the below-37.6 outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" seems reasonable or"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly high given"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the fresh jump to 38.4%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The Friday market may"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not have fully repriced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yet.\n\nThe historical"}
{"type":"thought","data":" path shows a clear "}
{"type":"thought","data":"decline from 38.5% on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 5 through 37.8%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on October 9 and 10,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" followed by a recovery"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 38.1% on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 12 and 38.4% on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 13.\n\nThe October 16 market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is mispriced relative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to Kalshi. The bench"}
{"type":"thought","data":" asks 0.69 for Yes while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the fair value is closer"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 0.85. A buy of Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.69 still offers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" strong positive expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value. The payout would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be roughly +44.9 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if the rating stays"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above 37.6%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirm a buy of Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.69 yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +23 to +30 tokens depending"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on the true probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A No bet would be heavily"}
{"type":"thought","data":" negative expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The plan is to report"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a confidence of 0.88"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and set max-price to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.74 to fill the order."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe available liquidity"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at the best ask is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"only about $31, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is far below the $100"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stake. The order may fail to fill entirely or rest at a worse price. I need to check how the bench handles order fills before finalizing the bet."}

{"type":"tool_call_update","toolCallId":"call-b9eeba33-d806-4b1d-a381-ba6b7a3941a4-20","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"content","content":{"type":"text","text":"1→\"\"\"`bench`: the only tool an agent has. Talks to the orchestrator over the round's Unix socket.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport os\nimport socket\nimport sys\n\n10→\ndef call(req: dict) -> dict:\n    path = os.environ.get(\"BENCH_SOCKET\")\n    if not path:\n        return {\"ok\": False, \"error\": \"BENCH_SOCKET not set: bench only works inside an AgentpitBench round\"}\n    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:\n        s.settimeout(60)\n        s.connect(path)\n        s.sendall(json.dumps(req).encode() + b\"\\n\")\n        buf = b\"\"\n20→        while not buf.endswith(b\"\\n\"):\n            chunk = s.recv(65536)\n            if not chunk:\n                break\n            buf += chunk\n    return json.loads(buf or b'{\"ok\": false, \"error\": \"no reply\"}')\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"bench\", description=\"Inspect the market and place your one bet.\")\n30→    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest=\"cmd\", required=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"market\", help=\"Market snapshot: question, description, outcomes, prices, end date\")\n    b = sub.add_parser(\"book\", help=\"Order book for one outcome\")\n    b.add_argument(\"--outcome\", required=True)\n    h = sub.add_parser(\"history\", help=\"Price history for the market\")\n    h.add_argument(\"--outcome\", required=True)\n    bet = sub.add_parser(\"bet\", help=\"Place your one 100-token bet.
